scope: Zero-update CPU weight-space audit; no quality qualification or causal convergence claim.
limitations: Historical ordinary down is a learned reference, not the exact frozen-caption target span.
Projection inputs and their covariance are not measured.
Different initializers and optimized targets can explain misalignment; this is not a sign bug.
The linear-delta energy statistic ignores activation weighting and full-model coupling.

proposed_single_new_toy_law.status: proposal only; no quality training launched
proposed_single_new_toy_law.mechanism: Remove PR227 exact initial teacher/student down-span alignment while retaining exact family reachability.
proposed_single_new_toy_law.basis_law: D_initial.T=Q@R; D_teacher=R.T@(sqrt(rho)*Q.T+sqrt(1-rho)*O.T), with deterministic thin-QR and lexicographic reorthogonalized canonical complement. Preserves down within-rank Gram/norms.
proposed_single_new_toy_law.fixed: Two BF16 sites, rank2, width16, token16, shared128x4 R2 bank, public sample_distributions_v1 initialization, source/time conditional learned critic, native RpGAN+KA2, original fixed streams, editing-only6400 updates, zero feature harm; no output optimization.
proposed_single_new_toy_law.evaluation: Fixed private panels; clean FAST generator; all fit/guard/test pools; output RMSE diagnostic only; no metric-based checkpoint/head/horizon selection.
proposed_single_new_toy_law.reachability: Both families can copy teacher down/up and set H/b/C=0; this is a witness, not the trained result. Actual trained particles must retain trainable nonzero C, live bank/router gradients, and code contribution under all four judges.
proposed_single_new_toy_law.cause_limit: New task and fit residual scale change together; this is a controlled task-span transfer test, not proof that weight-space misalignment uniquely causes full-Supra failure.
proposed_single_new_toy_law.launch_condition: Only after the full Supra fixed endpoints fail the declared improvement gate and the root freezes source/card/budgets.
proposed_single_new_toy_law.rho_basis: measured mean linear-delta energy capture; no scalar search
